td.style: padding: 18px 16px; text-align: left; font-size: 11.5px; color: rgb(15, 23, 42); line-height: 1.52;
td.div:
• SoD Invariant 1 (Dual Custody):
request.auth.principal != resource.submitter
Initiating requestor cannot approve own action.

• SoD Invariant 2 (Agent Containment):
!startsWith(principal, 'spiffe://')
Autonomous ADK agents are cryptographically denied direct production commit roles.

• SoD Invariant 3 (Audit Independence):
Mutually exclusive IAM group bindings between Operations Analysts and Compliance Auditors.
